values.review_scope: Exact-head review of WP-09 identity-root authority, alias/provenance semantics, deterministic serialization, privacy, path portability, and dependency proof only.
review_prompts: Can any display name, wake, snapshot, copied state, or alias establish or replace identity root authority?
Are root derivation, ordering, serialization, and provenance replay-deterministic?
Do substituted continuity, collisions, missing origin evidence, private data, and host paths fail closed?
Is #5825 terminal evidence current and is every WP-09 acceptance claim proven at exact HEAD?
